source: Monash Time Series Forecasting Repository / 58 Zenodo variant records
source_intent: Monash says all datasets are intended for research use. The 50 successful Zenodo records separately report open access and CC BY 4.0; honor the research-purpose notice pending clarification of any conflict.

method.metadata_source: Zenodo public record API for each record ID extracted individually from the repository audit table.
method.payload_method: Anonymous full HTTP GET of each record file through its official Zenodo content endpoint; no login or token.
method.parser: ZIP CRC validation followed by a TSF header/attribute and full series-row parse; count each record, observation, missing token, and per-series length min/median/max.
method.limitations: This pass verifies archive retrieval and raw series parsing, not a task-specific split, complete window count, GPU full-batch fit, or MLP non-saturation for every variant. Those remain separate gates.
method.retry_note: Eight first-pass HTTP 504 artifacts were retried on 2026-10-24; all eight subsequent full anonymous downloads passed ZIP CRC and TSF parsing.
